# Default Directory

![Default Directory function icon](../../../assets/function-icons/functions/path/10-constante-chemin.svg)

[Path functions](index.md) · [All functions](../index.md)

Context constant returning the installation directory containing the Graiphic Studio executable. This is distinct from Application Directory, the project, Documents and the process working directory. Deployment without a known GS installation reports an explicit unavailable-context diagnostic.
